title: Pacers @ Lakers — Glenn Robinson III jumper inside the arc credited as a 3; corrected 108-96 to 108-95 a week later (Jan 20-27, 2017)
incident_summary: With 1:49 remaining in the fourth quarter, Pacers guard/forward Glenn Robinson III made a jump shot from inside the three-point line, but the basket was incorrectly credited as a 3-point field goal. The game ended with an announced final of Lakers 108, Pacers 96. Seven days later, on Jan 27, 2017, the NBA announced the scoring error: the statistics were corrected, Robinson's scoring total was changed to five points, and the official final score became Lakers 108, Pacers 95 — a one-point correction that changed the combined total from 204 to 203. The league stated the error impacted the final score but not the final outcome.
scoring_play: Glenn Robinson III (IND) made jump shot from inside the three-point line — credited 3, should have been 2.
affected_player: Glenn Robinson III (IND) — scoring total corrected to 5 points

cause.detail: Suspected real-time 2-vs-3 misclassification by the game-night crew (shot location misjudged). The league announcement describes the error but does not state a cause — do not assert one beyond the misclassification itself. Notably, the in-game 2-vs-3 replay review did not catch it that night.

NBA announces the scoring error, corrects the statistics (Robinson to 5 points), and sets the final at Lakers 108, Pacers 95. League: error impacted the score but not the outcome. Video of the shot linked in the release.
